contexts.text: Offer him for a burnt-offering () = that He should sanctify Himself to the Divine.
To be offered for a burnt-offering = to be sanctified.
To offer a present to the man = to obtain favour... The presents they gave them represented such things... as ought to be offered to the Lord...
That the goods of truth were offered. Signified.
For the gifts which were offered to Jehovah signified such things as are offered to the Lord by man from the heart, and are accepted by the Lord. Explained. AC 9293:2.
Hence it is that when the meat-offering was offered... the libation also was offered.
To offer a gift upon the altar = all Divine worship, because Divine worship... consisted principally in offering burnt-offerings and sacrifices. AE 391:20.
